primary.title: Review and submit the prepared complaint
primary.why: Evidence for 7 location(s) is preserved. This incident type is urgent. Reporting starts platform takedown and police action.

dont: Do not contact or confront the accounts posting it.
Do not forward the media to friends 'for awareness' — every forward is another copy.

checklist.title: Capture every known URL (screenshot, HTML, media, hashes)
Export the evidence package and keep a copy offline
checklist.why: Hash-verified package with custody log for police/court.

checklist.title: Report each post to the platform as non-consensual intimate / morphed imagery
checklist.why: Platforms prioritise complaints from the depicted person about intimate or morphed images.

checklist.title: Create a StopNCII.org case from your own device
checklist.why: Blocks re-uploads on participating platforms without sharing the image.

checklist.title: Submit the NCRP complaint (cybercrime.gov.in) or call 1930
checklist.why: Starts official action; note the acknowledgement number here.

checklist.title: If platforms do not act, escalate to their Grievance Officer, then the Grievance Appellate Committee
checklist.why: Formal escalation route for intermediary complaints in India.

checklist.title: Enable monitoring for re-uploads and changes

top_gaps.question: Has the incident been reported?
top_gaps.why: Platform takedown and police action start only after a complaint; delays risk evidence loss and further spread.
top_gaps.next_evidence: Review and submit the prepared complaint (NCRP / platform).

top_gaps.question: Can re-uploads be blocked on participating platforms?
top_gaps.why: StopNCII.org hashes the image on your own device; participating platforms block matches.
top_gaps.next_evidence: Create a StopNCII case from your own device (the image never leaves it).

top_gaps.question: Does the depicted person's authentic appearance/voice differ from the media?
top_gaps.why: Authentic reference photos/voice recordings of the depicted person allow face/voice comparison and expose inconsistencies (moles, teeth, accent).
top_gaps.next_evidence: Upload 3–5 authentic photos or voice notes of the depicted person, with consent, marked as reference material.

disclaimer: This is process guidance, not legal advice. For legal decisions consult a lawyer or the police.
